title: Mystery!
author: Gene Welborn
description:
A homage to the Parker Brother's game CLUE™. The first half of the game is the 'setup' for the murder, the second half is the search for the murderer. Since the solution is randomly generated, it can be replayed. Also, there are shortcuts that will allow skipping most of the 'setup' portion of the game.

If the link is not working for you, try
